context_requirements: Expression of thyroid hormone receptors (THRA/THRB) and a functional thyroid hormone signaling axis
Presence of thyroid hormone response elements in accessible chromatin
Dependence on thyroid hormone for proliferation or survival
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of thyroid hormone receptor target gene signatures after treatment
Cell-line-selective responses correlating with THRA/THRB expression or thyroid lineage
